correctness.rationale: Petersen KG(5,2) unordered two-particle cubical model has 45,120,75 cells with signed ∂2∂1 composition zero. Rebuilt graph, all 12 pentagons and exactly six disjoint pairings. The corresponding 25-square integral torus cycles are ∂2-closed; with signs (+,+,−,−,−,+) their sum vanishes identically at chain level. Independent exact mod-3 rank(∂2)=70, so kernel rank5; explicit five selected square rows give 5×6 matrix whose six omitted-column minors are (−1,1,−1,1,−1,1), proving any five cycles integrally span kernel without rational-to-integral gap. Exact induced actions of all 120 S5 automorphisms permute oriented torus chains without signs. The invariant diagonal inclusion has no S5-equivariant integral retraction since transitivity forces its image divisible by six. Applies solely to unordered 2-particle Petersen configuration space.
